info.title: Task Management API
info.description:
RESTful API for a simple Task Management System.

Every endpoint except register and login requires a Sanctum bearer token. Records are scoped to their owner: another user's projects and tasks answer 403.

Listings accept `page` and `per_page` (default 15, maximum 100). Task listings also accept `status`, `priority` and `search`, which combine; an unknown filter value returns 422 rather than an empty result.

post.summary: Register a new user and issue an API token
Authenticate a user and issue an API token

Revoke the token used for the current request, leaving the user's other
tokens (issued to different devices) intact

get.summary: Summary figures for the authenticated user's own workload
List the authenticated user's projects, newest first

post.summary: Create a project owned by the authenticated user

get.description:
Reuses the same request and scopes as the per-project listing — only the
starting relation differs. Tasks under a soft-deleted project fall out
here, because the relation joins through projects.
get.summary: List every task the user owns, across all of their projects

get.description:
Filters compose: each scope is a no-op when its filter is absent, so any
combination of them narrows the same query.
get.summary: List the tasks of a project the user owns, newest first

post.summary: Add a task to a project the user owns

tasks_count.description:
Only present when the controller asked for it with withCount(),
so the resource never triggers a query of its own.

due_date.description:
Past dates are allowed on purpose, so existing overdue work can be
recorded rather than being rejected at the door.

project.description: Only present when the controller eager loaded the relation.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
